stories.headline: Two tankers hit near Khasab as Iran tightens control of Hormuz shipping
stories.summary: UKMTO reported two tankers struck by unknown projectiles near Khasab off Oman in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran blamed a naval mine in a restricted area, and the IRGC Navy warned it would act against ships transiting without Iranian coordination. Fars claimed at least 12 ships have hit mines over three days, and oil shipments through the strait fell 15%. One analysis argues Iran exaggerates the mine threat to extend its control.
stories.turkey: Disruption of Hormuz shipping raises energy prices and import costs for Türkiye and threatens Gulf trade routes.
